title: Overdue Follow-Up Backlog
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=followup:reminder days_overdue=*
| where days_overdue>0
| stats count as overdue_reminders, max(days_overdue) as worst_overdue by contact_name
| sort - worst_overdue
| head 20
description: Lists contacts with open follow-up reminders sorted by how many days overdue they are.
value: Networking debt compounds quietly; an overdue backlog turns good intentions into missed opportunities.
implementation: Export follow-up tasks with `days_overdue` and review the top twenty contacts each Monday morning.
visualization: Table of contacts with overdue reminder count and worst overdue days.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which people you meant to follow up with but keep putting off.
